title: Visual polish verified; live history preview still needs testing
summary: Completed the interrupted layout verification: 304 tests, 155 browser checks, learning journey and both platform exports passed. Existing development history URL timed out.

changes.detail: Remove default card elevation, distinguish tonal/outline/text buttons, preserve loading contrast and add keyboard focus borders.
Compact narrow teacher prompts and home hero; wrap lesson steps for narrow screens or enlarged text; bound bottom-tab labels.
Make explorer goal form expandable, keep filters in an RTL-aware horizontal row, flatten nested course rows and provide clear-filter recovery.
Give profile identity/goal clearer hierarchy and use meaningful navigation icons.
Add native safe-area containment to fullscreen coding editor; runtime documentation remains available in an accessible disclosure.
Corrected the populated visual fixture with a required learner goal and assertions for saved profile and visible heading; see academy-visual-fixture-correction-20261015.

validation.name: TypeScript, ESLint and regression suite
validation.detail: Fresh TypeScript and full app ESLint passed; all 304 tests passed. The browser script is excluded by the existing ESLint configuration; it was executed successfully.

validation.name: Responsive browser matrix
validation.detail: 155 checks: 144 route visits across 24 routes, English/French/Arabic and light/dark; six navigation checks; four goal-disclosure, loading/reply, short viewport and populated-state checks; recovery/completion check. Zero browser errors. Phone widths 320/390; home also 768/1280.

validation.name: Visual review
validation.detail: Reviewed fresh English populated home/profile/teacher, dark loading, narrow explorer and lesson tabs, short focused composer, Arabic dark teacher and Arabic light profile screenshots.

validation.name: Learning journey
validation.detail: Onboarding, teacher formula rendering, contextual lesson request, quiz/readiness, notes/bookmarks, real code success/error and grading, flashcards and restored state passed. Authentication and teacher responses used fixtures.

validation.name: Platform exports
validation.detail: Fresh web export and Android Hermes export passed. Android compiler required sandbox escalation; export is not an installed-device test.

validation.name: History archive
validation.detail: All four archive/preservation tests passed; append-only manifest check passed after the fixture report.

validation.name: Current development preview
validation.detail: Root HTTP returned 200, but browser navigation to http://localhost:8081/change-history timed out at 30 seconds and again at 120 seconds. No live preview link is claimed.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: Physical Android/iOS keyboard, native font scaling, screen readers, WebView formula rendering and frame-rate checks remain untested. No paid teacher request or deployment. Screenshots are local test captures, not historical app builds.
